review.reviewer: Codex implementation and independent impeccable finish reviewer
findings_resolved: CLI reservation and native thread limits now span preparation through final holdout/reporting
Desktop explanatory form rows occupy their own full-width row
Disclosure summaries meet the mobile 44px touch target
Background polling does not dismiss rejected save/cancel actions or discard unsaved fields

implementation.shared_budget: Local-user SQLite FIFO queue shared by API instances, checkouts, dashboard research and supported research CLIs
implementation.service_reserve: One compute core, two when compute cores >= 8; max(8 GiB, 25% of physical RAM)
implementation.reservation: Effective worker CPU slots and aggregate estimated worker/coordinator memory; nested seed/fold pools inherit the parent lease
implementation.watchdog: Sample aggregate process-tree RSS every approximately one second; stop owned research on memory breach or monitoring loss
implementation.lifecycle: Queued/running/terminal state, bounded supervisor-PID handoff, durable restart review, queued and running cancellation, dead-owner recovery retaining surviving owned process capacity
implementation.frontend: Backtest/Optimization host capacity disclosure: authenticated limit edits, queue positions, reservations, cancellation, per-job sampled peak RSS, completed measurements, explicit stale/error states

environment.host: Apple M4, 10 logical CPUs, 4 detected performance compute cores, 32 GiB RAM
environment.browser: Google Chrome 155.0.8059.85 via Playwright chrome channel
environment.broker: No broker connection or orders; Redis and detached-process tests use isolated registries

coverage: Atomic CPU and memory admission; FIFO head-of-line behavior; service reserves
Durable, authenticated, localhost-only budget changes and rejection of incompatible reductions
Inherited reservation identity and nested pool bounds; setup-error cleanup
CLI preparation, fold pool and final holdout remain under one reservation
Real Redis/detached-process contention, manager restart, queued cancellation and running cancellation
Independent 50ms heartbeat under competing CPU research; maximum observed interval asserted below 1 second
Supervisor crash cleanup; owned-child termination and capacity reclamation
Injected memory breach and measurement-source loss terminate only the owned research group and retain failure evidence
Desktop/mobile configuration, queue cancellation after reload, keyboard focus, touch targets, no horizontal overflow, retained action errors and unsaved inputs
Existing browser fixtures declare the pre-existing drift-review read endpoint so unrelated safety/recovery workflows remain isolated

limitations: Admission estimates, scheduler priority and sampled RSS are not OS hard CPU/RAM isolation
RSS may double-count shared pages; short peaks between samples may be missed
Unrelated processes, separate OS users, or processes configured to use separate admission databases are outside the shared budget
The heartbeat experiment validates local scheduling and queue bypass, not real TWS/Gateway execution, broker responsiveness or paper soak behavior
Target-host scaling remains P2-09; all P0 readiness gates and live-capital permissions remain unchanged
